newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: G.K.Goh sees better second-half results.
newsitem.headline: G.K.Goh sees better second-half results.

text.p: Stock brokerage G.K. Goh Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it expected the second-half of its financial year to be better than the first half.
The company said in a statement its first-half net profit declined 1.7 percent year-on-year to Singapore $8.9 million.
"The second half year has begun strongly in line with the much higher turnover in our major markets," it said.

"Profits for this period are expected to be greater than in the first half. Barring unforeseen circumstances, profits for the current financial year should be better than the preceding year," it added.
